title: Timed out request is dropped on flush
description: Verifies that a request that timed out while queued is not sent to the shell when flushed after handshake.
given: A client with a 1000ms invoke timeout before handshake
when: invoke is called, timeout fires, then ready arrives
then: Only hello is posted (the timed-out request is dropped and never sent)
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::does not send a queued request that already timed out
